name: SHOPS AT REDBIRD
summary: Shops at Redbird is a shopping center in southwest Dallas that has evolved from its origins as a traditional mall to serve the local community's retail needs. With convenient hours and a variety of stores, it provides accessible shopping options for residents in the Camp Wisdom Road area.
demographics: Shops at Redbird serves a diverse, predominantly middle-income community in southwest Dallas, with a significant African American and Hispanic population. The trade area attracts families and value-conscious shoppers seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services. Typical visitors range from young families to middle-aged households with moderate incomes, prioritizing accessibility and practical shopping options over luxury experiences.
description: Shops at Redbird is a shopping destination located in the heart of southwest Dallas on West Camp Wisdom Road, serving the local community with convenient retail and dining options. Originally developed as Redbird Mall in the 1970s, this center has undergone significant transformation over the decades to better serve the evolving needs of the surrounding neighborhoods. The property has been reimagined from its traditional enclosed mall format to adapt to modern retail trends and community preferences. With operating hours from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Shops at Redbird provides accessible shopping for residents of the Camp Wisdom area and beyond. The center maintains a solid 3.8-star rating from over 1,200 Google reviews, reflecting its role as a practical shopping option for the local community.
